zones.label: 1: Count the agreements
zones.summary: The agent and the human agree on 18 of 20 resources, an agreement rate of 0.90.
facts: Both say ready: 1. Both say not ready: 17. They disagree on 2, one each way.
The agent says ready 2 of 20 times and the human says ready 2 of 20 times.

zones.label: 2: Subtract what luck gives
zones.summary: Chance agreement is 0.82, so most of the 0.90 agreement is expected by luck.
facts: Chance of both saying not ready: 0.90 × 0.90 = 0.81.
Two raters who answered "not ready" at random 90 percent of the time would agree 82 percent of the time.

zones.label: 3: Kappa
facts: It is the observed agreement beyond chance, divided by the most agreement chance leaves room for.
The agent found only one of the two resources that the human judged ready.
Always show the count table beside kappa.

quiz.question: Which panel shows that the agent and human agree on 18 of 20 resources?
Which panel shows that most of the 0.90 agreement is expected by chance?
Which panel adds 0.10 × 0.10 and 0.90 × 0.90 to get 0.82?
quiz.explanation: Both say ready, plus both say not ready.
